# Inspo MCP

Inspo MCP provides read-only design-reference search across captured production websites, components, color palettes, typography, and page structure for coding agents.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/inspo-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Compare** (read-only): Compare 2-4 captured sites across palette, typefaces, macrostructure, mode, style tags, type/spacing/radius scales and container width.
- **Find by color** (read-only): Real sites whose extracted palette sits near a hex colour (OKLAB distance, so 'close' means the same colour family, not just the same hue).
- **Find components** (read-only): Real sites featuring a specific UI component (hero, pricing, features, cta, nav, footer, testimonial, logo-cloud, faq, stat), with a…
- **Find examples for macrostructure** (read-only): Real sites exemplifying one of the 19 named macrostructures.
- **Find reference components** (read-only): The canonical reference components as an index.
- **Find similar** (read-only): A screen's nearest design neighbours - ranked by design-similarity embeddings where available, else by macrostructure / industry / style…
- **Get collection** (read-only): Fetch one issue by slug, including the editor's blurb and ordered screen list.
- **Get design system** (read-only): The full DESIGN.md for one screen - real fonts, frequency-ranked palette, CSS variables, detected tech, colour roles, type ramp.
- **Get filters** (read-only): Every value the filters accept.
- **Get reference jsx** (read-only): The full canonical JSX source for one reference component, including the header stamp naming its macrostructure / theme / states.
- **Get screen** (read-only): Fetch the full record for one screen by slug - every viewport variant, palette, fonts, tech stack, designer credit.
- **Get site pages** (read-only): A site's captured pages as an ordered flow (landing → pricing → features → ...) with titles, northstars and thumbnails - how a real…
- **List collections** (read-only): List every editor-curated issue.
- **Recommend** (read-only): Orchestrator - start here for a brief.
- **Search screens** (read-only): Search the archive of real website screenshots.
